about.title: About Me: Bridging Business Vision with Engineering Rigor
about.subtitle: With over 6 years of software development experience, my mission is turning complex business challenges into functional, secure, and intuitive digital products.
about.bio_p1: I am a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer specialized in modern high-performance ecosystems. I comfortably navigate from understanding user and stakeholder pain points to full solution delivery, operating with autonomy throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
about.bio_p2: I believe engineering is ultimately about driving measurable business results: lowering costs, automating manual workflows, and crafting digital experiences that delight end users.
about.pillar1_desc: Proven ability to take on the whole product: user-centric design, resilient APIs, clean database modeling, and automated cloud deployments.
about.pillar2_desc: Commitment to Clean Code, automated testing (unit & integration), SOLID principles, and sustainable architectures that make products easy to scale.
about.pillar3_desc: Effective communication with business stakeholders, recruiters, and engineering leads, fostering transparent planning and reliable deliveries.
